name: slop-detect-mcp
description: MCP server that scores any landing page against the AI-design-slop fingerprint (deterministic 0-100, real Chromium) and an AEO axis, and builds fix prompts.

transport.notes: Local stdio MCP server. Install via npm (slop-detect-mcp). It calls the public slop-detect.com API; no API key required.

tools.name: scan_page
tools.description: Score a URL against the design-slop fingerprint (optionally the copy axis). Returns score, tier, grade, and the patterns that fired.

tools.name: check_aeo
tools.description: Score whether AI engines (ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity) can fetch, read and cite a page. Higher is better.

tools.name: fix_prompt
tools.description: Build a ready-to-paste prompt instructing a coding agent how to de-slop a page from a scan result or URL.
